and at its declared top (y 130), not mid-flight (findings: 0.998 / 0.742 / 0.0 / 0.0 at 6ef440a).

reports the rest as an error ('text is clipped by an overflow:hidden ancestor: 1 line(s) and 29 character(s)
are hidden') - the contract makes hidden text an error, and the family lists it. Lint warns on the
-webkit-line-clamp (text-overflow).
